summary_zh: 开普敦拉网渔民黎明乘风出海，儿子尤素夫在岸边满怀期待；面对被困网中的小鲨鱼，父亲温柔解救小鲨鱼重归大海，黄昏时为尤素夫带回一条大鱼和一枚幸运鲨鱼齿礼物。

sentences.text: One special Friday Yusuf’s father gets dressed before a flicker of light brightens the sky.
sentences.translation_zh: 一个特别的星期五，天边尚未泛起微光，尤素夫的父亲便已起身穿戴整齐。

sentences.text: He pulls on his heavy weather-proof jacket and the green woollen cap that covers his ears.
sentences.translation_zh: 他套上厚实防风防雨的厚夹克，戴上遮住耳朵的绿色毛线帽。

tokens.gloss_zh: 关系代词，引导定语从句，修饰 cap

sentences.text: He waves his boy goodbye.
sentences.translation_zh: 他向自己的儿子挥手告别。

sentences.text: Yusuf’s eyes brighten when Papa says, “Today is the day I will catch a fish and bring a gift home for you.”
sentences.translation_zh: 当爸爸说“今天我要捕一条鱼，并给你带一份礼物回家”时，尤素夫的眼睛顿时亮了起来。

sentences.text: A fish and a gift?
Oh, what will it be?
Papa cycles down to Muizenberg Beach.
sentences.translation_zh: 爸爸骑车赶往米森堡海滩。

sentences.text: Squeak squeak go the wheels all the way to Surfer’s Corner.
sentences.translation_zh: 车轮一路吱吱作响，一直响到冲浪者之角。

sentences.text: Gulls circle the sky.
“Whaaat?
Whaaat?
Whaaat?” they cry.
“What will you bring back for Yusuf?”
Papa rings his bell.
“Wait and see what it will be!”
The fishermen watch the sun rise.
sentences.translation_zh: 渔民们注视着太阳升起。

sentences.text: They check their nets.
They check their oars.
They listen to the wind.
They drag their boats down to the water.
Yusuf’s grandfather, Oupa Salie was a treknet fisherman.
sentences.translation_zh: 尤素夫的爷爷萨利阿公曾是一名传统拉网渔民。

sentences.text: Before him his father, Oupagrootjie Ridwaan, knew the sea too.
sentences.translation_zh: 在他之前，他的父亲里德万太公同样熟悉大海。

sentences.text: The boat rides into the waves.
Papa’s arms stretch to the oar.
His leg braces against the side.
His neck strains, his back muscles ripple.
sentences.translation_zh: 他的脖子紧绷，背部肌肉泛起波纹。

sentences.text: Papa sings as he works: “Drop and swish.
sentences.translation_zh: 爸爸劳作时唱着歌：“下网呼呼响。

sentences.text: Find a fish.
Pull and plop.
Don’t you stop.”
All day long Yusuf looks at the sky.
sentences.translation_zh: 一整天，尤素夫都在望着天空。

sentences.text: It is bright and clear and windless.
sentences.translation_zh: 天空晴朗清澈，没有一丝风。

sentences.text: A fish and a gift!
What will Papa bring home from the sea?
sentences.translation_zh: 爸爸会从海里带什么回家呢？

sentences.text: Sometimes he brings a beautiful shell.
sentences.translation_zh: 有时他会带回一枚美丽的贝壳。

sentences.text: Sometimes he brings a jewel green bottle rinsed by the waves.
sentences.translation_zh: 有时他会带回一只被海浪冲刷干净的宝石绿玻璃瓶。

sentences.text: Some days Yusuf’s father brings a story.
sentences.translation_zh: 有些日子，尤素夫的父亲会带回一个故事。

sentences.text: Like the time they found sea turtles on the sand, hundreds washed up in a storm.
sentences.translation_zh: 比如有一次他们在沙滩上发现了海龟，数百只在暴风雨中被冲上了岸。

tokens.gloss_zh: 副词，与 wash 构成搭配 wash up 表示被冲上岸

sentences.text: “Whaaat?
Whaaat?
Whaaat?” cried the gulls.
“What will you do to help the turtles?”
sentences.translation_zh: “你们会做些什么来帮助海龟呢？”

sentences.text: Papa said, “We saved those turtles, I tell you straight.
sentences.translation_zh: 爸爸说：“我实话告诉你，我们救下了那些海龟。

sentences.text: We sent them back to the ocean, every last one.”
sentences.translation_zh: 我们把它们全送回了大海，一只不落。”

sentences.text: Always Papa brings a song.
sentences.translation_zh: 爸爸总是会带回一首歌。

sentences.text: He sings the song while he pulls the oars.
He sings the song while he pulls the nets.
He sings the song as he winds the ropes.
He sings the song as he cycles home.
sentences.translation_zh: 他骑车回家时也唱着这首歌：

sentences.text: “Drop and swish.
Find a fish.
Pull and plop.
Don’t you stop.”
Ouma Safiya wants a nice fat yellowtail for her supper.
sentences.translation_zh: 萨菲亚奶奶晚饭想吃一条肥美的黄尾鱼。

sentences.text: Mother wants a new dress.
sentences.translation_zh: 妈妈想要一件新连衣裙。

sentences.text: “Don’t be silly,” says Ouma.
“You’ll be lucky if they catch even a tiny crab.
sentences.translation_zh: “他们哪怕能抓到一只小螃蟹就算走运了。

sentences.text: More likely it will be fish tail Friday.
sentences.translation_zh: 更有可能又是一个‘鱼尾星期五’（捕不到什么像样的鱼）。

sentences.text: There’s not so many fish left in the sea.”
sentences.translation_zh: 海里已经没有那么多鱼了。”

sentences.text: Yusuf holds Ouma’s hand.
They cross the road at the bathing cabins.
sentences.translation_zh: 他们在更衣木屋旁穿过马路。

sentences.text: “Whaaat?
Whaaat?
Whaaat?” cry the gulls perched on the bright rooftops.
sentences.translation_zh: 什么？”栖歇在鲜艳屋顶上的海鸥叫喊着。

sentences.text: “What is for supper?”
Last year the fishermen fought with the surfers.
sentences.translation_zh: 去年，渔民们和冲浪者起过冲突。

tokens.gloss_zh: 上一个的；过去的（与 year 结合表示去年）

sentences.text: Angry fists and shouting words.
sentences.translation_zh: 愤怒的拳头和斥责的话语。

sentences.text: “Whaaat?
Whaaat?
Whaaat?” cried the gulls.
“There’s enough sea for everybody,” said Yusuf’s father.
sentences.translation_zh: “大海足够所有人共享，”尤素夫的父亲说。

phrases.gloss_zh: 足够所有人共享的大海

sentences.text: He showed them the fishing licence that had been Oupa Salie’s.
sentences.translation_zh: 他向他们展示了曾属于萨利阿公的捕鱼许可证。

tokens.gloss_zh: 关系代词，引导定语从句，修饰 fishing licence
过去完成时助动词，与 been 构成过去完成时

sentences.text: “Waves for all.
Water for free.”

tokens.gloss_zh: 介词，与 free 构成短语 for free 表示免费

sentences.text: Ouma Safiya watches through her binoculars, her fingers curled in curiosity.
sentences.translation_zh: 萨菲亚奶奶透过望远镜注视着，好奇地弯曲着手指。

sentences.text: The shark siren sounds.
Swimmers run back to the sand and grab their towels.
sentences.translation_zh: 游泳的人们跑回沙滩，抓起毛巾。

sentences.text: Surfers rush to the shore, carrying their boards under their arms.
sentences.translation_zh: 冲浪者奔向岸边，手臂下夹着冲浪板。

sentences.text: Under the showers they strip off their wetsuits.
sentences.translation_zh: 在淋浴喷头下，他们脱掉了潜水服。

sentences.text: “Whaaat?
Whaaat?
Whaaat?” cry the gulls.
“What will Yusuf’s father bring from the ocean?”
sentences.translation_zh: “尤素夫的父亲会从海洋里带回什么呢？”

sentences.text: Yusuf’s father and uncle and cousins heave and pull.
sentences.translation_zh: 尤素夫的父亲、叔叔和几个堂表亲用力拉拽着渔网。

sentences.text: A little shark has been caught.
It twists and thrashes in the waves.
Yusuf’s father untangles the nets, singing to the shark: “Drop and swish.
sentences.translation_zh: 尤素夫的父亲解开缠绕的渔网，对着小鲨鱼唱道：“下网呼呼响。

sentences.text: Find a fish.
Pull and plop.
Don’t you stop.”
When the shark at last is free it streaks back into the waves, leaving only one fat yellowtail in the net.
sentences.translation_zh: 当小鲨鱼终于重获自由时，它迅速窜回波浪中，网里只留下一条肥美的黄尾鱼。

sentences.text: Ouma Safiya will be pleased.
sentences.translation_zh: 萨菲亚奶奶一定会很高兴的。

sentences.text: The men pull the boat in and coil up the cables.
sentences.translation_zh: 大家把船拉上岸，把缆绳盘好。

sentences.text: A hard white triangle catches Papa’s finger.
sentences.translation_zh: 一个坚硬的白色三角碰到了爸爸的手指。

sentences.text: “Whaaat?
Whaaat?
Whaaat?” cry the gulls.
“What did you bring back for Yusuf?”
As the sun goes down, Papa answers the gulls.
sentences.translation_zh: 夕阳西下，爸爸回应着海鸥：

sentences.text: “A lucky shark tooth for my boy.”
sentences.translation_zh: “一颗给我儿子的幸运鲨鱼齿。”

sentences.text: At home Yusuf holds his gift up to the stars.
sentences.translation_zh: 在家里，尤素夫将他的礼物高高举向繁星。
